unique_retained: Secret redaction before durable effect/durable_memory persistence is a donor invariant worth preserving as defense in depth.
The mutable active_turns.effect_id session slot is explicitly unsuitable as the Frankenstein-2.0 lifecycle identity; immutable tool_use_id or equivalent invocation_id is mandatory.

Perception Control has one mechanical tier source of truth: COMPUTE_OFF prevents compute/inference/memory/persistence, OUTPUT_OFF allows internal compute but blocks egress/persistence, MEMORY_OFF allows inference but blocks memory matching/persistence.
Dependency taint is resolved from the central DEPENDENCY_DAG, not caller-supplied dependency claims; blocked dependencies propagate NOT_COMPUTED/value=None.
Realtime response cancellation and barge-in clear pending function calls before execution; cancelled model expression must not leak into real tool effects.

Frankenstein 2.0 therefore requires immutable per-invocation identity from admission through execution, outcome, re-entry and completion.

perception_control.py makes disabled computation epistemically explicit: COMPUTE_OFF and taint-blocked dependencies produce NOT_COMPUTED/value=None before compute, and dependency truth comes from a central DAG. OUTPUT_OFF and MEMORY_OFF remain distinct from COMPUTE_OFF.
semantic_atoms.world_substrate_delta: WorldNeed/WorldSlice and GRID cell controls must preserve KNOWN/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/NOT_COMPUTED separately and propagate protected-dimension taint through transformation chains; a disabled variable may not be silently reconstructed downstream.

semantic_atoms.claim: realtime_gespraech.py keeps emitted function calls pending until response.done; any non-completed response clears pending calls, and barge-in clears them before truncating/cancelling the response. A cancelled spoken/model turn therefore has an explicit donor-side barrier against later executing already-emitted pending tools.
semantic_atoms.boundary: This protects the Realtime expression/tool bridge only; it is not the canonical EffectGate and does not prove global effect enforcement.
